priority.description:
How severe a violation of this rule this result indicates.
Recommended range is 0 - 4, like Jira tickets. P0/P1 are critical, P2 are less so, and P3/P4 are nice to fix.

message.description: The message corresponding to this result.

recommendation.description: An optional recommendation for action to correct the violation.

relatedEntities.description:
An optional list of entity IDs to accompany the {@link DataValidationRuleResult}.
May not contain all relevant entities due to limitations of array fields in the type system.

relatedFields.description:
An optional list of fields to accompany the {@link DataValidationRuleResult}.
May not contain all relevant fields due to limitations of array fields in the type system.

status.description: It indicates the validation status of a {@link DataValidationRule#action}

output.description:
It its a string representation of the output of a {@link DataValidationRule#action} for example ‘DNE', or ‘EXISTS’.
It could be any string, but should be included in the {@link DataValidationRule#possibleOutputs}.

title: A specific violation of a {@link DataValidationRule}, as returned by the target {@link DataValidationRule#action action}.
name: DataValidationRuleResult
